stem.label: quinone
stem.alt: Skeletal formula of quinone, labelled quinone: a six-membered ring with two C=C double bonds, and a C=O group on each of the two opposite carbons.

stem.text: Which statement about quinone is correct?

A.text: Quinone is non-planar and has an overall dipole moment.

B.text: Quinone is non-planar and **does not** have an overall dipole moment.

C.text: Quinone is planar and has an overall dipole moment.

D.text: Quinone is planar and **does not** have an overall dipole moment.
